scope: User-authorized broad operator exploration; single-user multi-agent; eight disjoint GPUs
numerical_contract: Existing FP64 O atol .006 rtol .015; natural-log LSE atol .0003 rtol .0001. Any candidate numeric failure retained, no tolerance relaxation.
grid: Every B4 fixed partition and binary hierarchy; native automatic split, own fixed split64/N64; dynamic v2 + emptyguard split32/64/128 N32/64; v3 N64. Screen is not fully tuned global best or full application.
retry_policy: No automatic retry. Source changes get new explicit attempts and separate evidence.
hypotheses: Can static same-lane canonical U avoid region-wide shared scratch round trips?
Does skipping empty shards remove measurable overhead without changing computation?
Do longer regions and >L2 BF16 working sets change relative performance? FP8 bytes and strong fixed/hierarchy remain required before application claims.
